analysis.summary: Akiko Global Services Limited discussed its Q1 FY27 financial performance and strategic initiatives during its investor call on July 31, 2026. Management revised its FY27 revenue guidance upward to INR 325 crore to INR 350 crore, supported by offline branch expansion and digital acquisition. The company is actively launching its AkikoPay platform on both Android and iOS while integrating additional financial products like insurance and mutual funds. Management reiterated that it has no plans for fundraising over the next six to twelve months. In its Q1 FY27 investor presentation, Akiko Global Services Limited reported strong operational momentum with monthly loan disbursals exceeding ₹450 crore and monthly credit card sourcing reaching 17,000-18,000 cards.

guidance.claim: Management revised its FY27 revenue guidance to between INR 325 crores and INR 350 crores.
guidance.quote: Earlier, I had given a target of INR300 crores. Now I am revising this guidance. I am very comfortable to get INR325 crores to INR350 crores this FY27.

guidance.claim: Management expects to achieve a PAT margin of 9% to 11% for the current financial year.
guidance.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year.

guidance.claim: Management targets maintaining a year-on-year revenue CAGR of 70% to 100% over the next 3 years.
guidance.quote: Because my vision is very clear for the next 3 years that our CAGR will remain the same at 70% to 100% year-on-year basis.

guidance.claim: Management stated it is confident in meeting its FY27 revenue target of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability.
guidance.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

guidance.claim: Management expects minimum revenue growth of 70% to 100% in FY27.
guidance.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

guidance.claim: The company targets reaching INR 1,000 crores in revenue and PAT margins of 12% to 13% by 2030.
guidance.quote: We have a proper clear vision that we build INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins further to 12% to 13%.

guidance.claim: Management expects revenue for FY27 to be above INR 300 crores.
guidance.quote: Otherwise, I am expecting my outlook for 2027 is INR300 crores. That is not going below INR300 crores, this is going to be above INR300 crores.

guidance.claim: Management expects Q1 FY27 revenue to be between INR 65 crores and INR 70 crores.
guidance.quote: I am looking forward for this quarter with good quarter numbers, INR65 crores to INR70 crores with good margins.

guidance.claim: Management expects 5% to 10% quarter-on-quarter growth in loan distribution over the next two quarters.
guidance.quote: I am expecting 5% to 10% growth quarter-on-quarter. I am expecting for next two quarters.

demand_outlook.claim: The company's core offline business and distribution network are growing by 4% to 7% month-on-month.
demand_outlook.quote: Unlike other fintechs that burn money in their initial years, we are not focusing on losing money at all because our offline business, our core business, and our distribution are increasing month-on-month by 4% to 7%.

demand_outlook.claim: Personal loans represent the fastest growing loan product for the company.
The company records daily deposits of INR 2 lakh to INR 3 lakh into its AkikoPay wallet.
demand_outlook.quote: And we are seeing INR2 lakh to INR3 lakh deposited into our wallet every day, which I am expecting to reach more than INR10 lakh or INR20 lakh from next month onwards.

demand_outlook.claim: The company disburses more than 16,000 credit cards on a monthly basis.
demand_outlook.quote: If we talk about the credit card segment, which used to be our core business at one time, today we successfully disburse 16,000+ credit cards on a month-on-month basis.

demand_outlook.claim: The monthly loan disbursement run rate has reached INR 400 crores+, translating to an annual book of INR 5,000 crores.
demand_outlook.quote: Currently, we have reached a monthly disbursement run rate of INR400 crores+, which if we count annually, our book has become INR5,000 crores as of today.

demand_outlook.claim: Physical branch presence increases digital lead conversion rates from 10% to 60%-80%.
demand_outlook.quote: Where our digital conversion rate is 10%, with physical presence, that conversion reaches 60% to 80%, which we have felt over the last two years.

demand_outlook.claim: Almost 70% of credit card sourcing is conducted digitally.
demand_outlook.quote: The most important thing is that almost 70% of sourcing is now happening digitally, which is improving productivity and making customer acquisition costs better, and targeting capabilities are also becoming stronger.

demand_outlook.claim: The AkikoPay application has recorded over 50,000 Android downloads.
demand_outlook.quote: So far, we have done some 50,000+ Android downloads, and we have negligible cost on that.

capex_expansion.claim: Akiko operates 25 branches across 19 cities in India.
capex_expansion.quote: In India, we have 25 branches. For DSAs, there are no separate ones because we don't do hard calling or hard selling under DSAs. So, we have 25 branches across 19 cities in India.

capex_expansion.claim: The company recently added branches in Kolkata, UP, and Hyderabad, with plans to open new branches in Indore and Kerala.
capex_expansion.quote: This year we recently added a Kolkata branch, two branches in UP, one more branch in Hyderabad, and currently these are the ones. Over the next 2-3 months, a couple of more branches are lined up, with one opening in Indore and one towards Kerala.

capex_expansion.claim: All branches operated by the company are taken on rent or lease.
capex_expansion.quote: All are on rent/lease. None are owned.

capex_expansion.claim: Development of the iOS version of AkikoPay is proceeding as planned for rollout in upcoming months.
capex_expansion.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

capex_expansion.claim: The company has expanded its company-owned branch network across multiple cities.
capex_expansion.quote: Along with this, we have also expanded our company-owned branch presence in multiple cities.

capex_expansion.claim: Akiko has spent approximately INR 1 crore in total on building technology infrastructure for AkikoPay.
capex_expansion.quote: Not much, around INR1 crores in total so far on building technology etc, that is it.

capex_expansion.claim: The company expanded its footprint from 3-4 branches in the previous quarter to 16 branches across India.
capex_expansion.quote: I mean, where we had three or four branches in the last quarter, today we have 16 branches across India.

capex_expansion.claim: AkikoPay is expected to go live on iOS within the current month after clearing compliance requirements.
capex_expansion.quote: Now within this month, AkikoPay will be live on iOS , we didn't market our AkikoPay properly, didn't tell our employees to market, our customers to download because 70% of the customers we need have iOS.

capex_expansion.claim: Mutual fund and insurance offerings are expected to go live on AkikoPay by August following IRDAI licensing.
capex_expansion.quote: So mutual fund and insurance going to be live by August onwards because for that I have applied for some IRDAI license.

margins_costs.claim: The company's average payout on unsecured loan disbursements stands at 3.10%.
margins_costs.quote: In unsecured, our average payout itself is 3.10%.

margins_costs.claim: Newly opened branches contributed to profitability in Q1 FY27 after causing slight margin stress in the previous quarter.
margins_costs.quote: As I mentioned last time, our profit faced slight stress last quarter because we opened several branches across multiple cities. This time, those branches have contributed to profitability, enabling us to deliver good growth this quarter.

margins_costs.claim: PAT margins could rise to 12% to 14% next year if AkikoPay performs well.
margins_costs.quote: Sir, I am confident of 9% to 11% for this year. If AkikoPay works very well, next year that will go up to 12% to 14%.

margins_costs.claim: Akiko Global achieved revenue growth and preserved profitability through momentum in card sourcing and lending operations.
margins_costs.quote: The Company delivered robust revenue growth while maintaining healthy profitability, supported by sustained momentum across its credit card sourcing and lending businesses, reflecting the resilience of its diversified business model.

margins_costs.claim: AkikoPay achieves approximately 40% lower customer acquisition cost compared to traditional distribution channels.
margins_costs.quote: ~40% lower CAC vs traditional channels, enabled by a lean, digital-first model

margins_costs.claim: Q4 margins faced pressure due to planned investments in branch expansion and technology infrastructure.
margins_costs.quote: This was due to our planned investment towards branch expansion, this was the most important thing, in which some of our money has been spent on that.

margins_costs.claim: Geopolitical issues around the Iran region caused temporary margin pressure on Dubai operations.
margins_costs.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

margins_costs.claim: The company delivered a PAT margin of 10.3% for FY26 against its target of 9% to 11%.
margins_costs.quote: I had given a vision that 9% to 11% PAT could be maintained, that we did of 10.3%.

margins_costs.claim: Akiko's customer acquisition cost is INR 10 to INR 15 compared to competitors spending INR 250.
margins_costs.quote: Where Paytm, PhonePe or CRED spends around INR250 to acquire a customer, there our cost comes to INR10 to INR15.

margins_costs.claim: Employee costs increased due to deploying personnel across newly opened branches.
margins_costs.quote: Yes, correct. Because branches have been increased, so our employees have been deployed there.

orders_capacity.claim: Card disbursements of 18,000 cards yield around INR 6 crores in monthly revenue.
orders_capacity.quote: And if I calculate for our 18,000 cards, it comes to around INR6 crores.

orders_capacity.claim: Management aims to increase employee strength to 1,400–1,500 and loan disbursements to INR 1,000 crores by December.
orders_capacity.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

orders_capacity.claim: The company currently employs 16 personnel on its technology team and around 700 in sales out of a total staff of approximately 950.
orders_capacity.quote: Look, currently on the tech side, we have a total of 16 people -- 16 people on the tech side. On the sales side, we have odd 700 people.

orders_capacity.claim: Monthly loan disbursals surpassed ₹450 crore and credit card sourcing reached 17,000–18,000 cards in Q1 FY27.
orders_capacity.quote: Operational execution remained strong during the quarter, with monthly loan disbursals increasing to over ₹450 crore, while monthly credit card sourcing scaled to 17,000–18,000 cards, driven by the Company's expanding distribution capabilities, technology-enabled customer acquisition platform, and deep banking and NBFC partnerships.

orders_capacity.claim: The company has cumulatively sourced more than 15 lakh credit cards.
The total combined workforce including employees and channel partners has crossed 900+.
orders_capacity.quote: Reflecting this scale-up, our total combined workforce, including employees and channel partners, has now crossed 900+, which is a very strong growth compared to last year.

orders_capacity.claim: Akiko has built partnerships with over 40 banks and NBFCs, adding 20 to 25 new partners during FY26.
orders_capacity.quote: And we have built partnerships with 40+ banks and NBFCs, in which 20 to 25 new partnerships have been built this year.

orders_capacity.claim: The company employs 486 staff members alongside 430 commission-based channel partners.
orders_capacity.quote: The number I have given you is around 486 our employees and rest 430 are our channel partners in field who are commission agents.

orders_capacity.claim: Secured loans account for 20% of the loan book while unsecured loans make up 80%.
orders_capacity.quote: In secured, we are doing only 20% of business. In unsecured, we are doing 80% of business in our book.

orders_capacity.claim: The current loan book consists of INR 320 crores in unsecured loans and INR 80 crores in secured loans.
orders_capacity.quote: INR320 crores unsecured, INR80 crores secured.

capital_allocation.claim: The company has no fundraising plans for the next 6 months to 1 year due to strong support from bank CC limits.
capital_allocation.quote: No, sir. There is absolutely no plan for fundraising right now. Even banks are supporting us very well. So, our CC limits are well aligned. So, no need for any fundraising for the next 6 months or 1 year.

capital_allocation.claim: Receivable days decreased from 133 days to 110 days and are expected to decline below 90 days in Q2.
capital_allocation.quote: From 133 days, receivable days are coming down to 110 days. In Q2, I see receivable days coming down to within 90 days.

capital_allocation.claim: Management explicitly rejects building a cash-burn fintech model for AkikoPay.
capital_allocation.quote: And one thing I would like to clearly say here, we are not building any cash-burn fintech model.

capital_allocation.claim: The company completed its technology and operational integrations without raising external funds.
capital_allocation.quote: If the Dubai issue was not there and if we had not invested -- you see, today we have completed almost all our integrations without any investment, without any fund-raising.

risks_headwinds.claim: War conditions created pressure on Dubai operations, resulting in quarterly Dubai revenue of INR 1.25 crores.
risks_headwinds.quote: In Dubai, due to war, our total revenue for the entire quarter was INR1.25 crores.

risks_headwinds.claim: Geopolitical issues around the Iran region disrupted Dubai business revenues and compressed margins in Q4.
risks_headwinds.quote: And some of our margin pressure has come in Dubai operations, there has been temporary margin pressure due to the current geopolitical situation, as you all know, around the Iran region.

management_commitments.quote: Sir, our vision is that in this quarter, our employee count should reach 1,400 to 1,500, plus by December end, we will reach around INR1,000 crores disbursement.

management_commitments.quote: Management remains confident of achieving its FY27 revenue guidance of ₹300–325 crore with healthy profitability, supported by continued operational execution, growing contribution from digital initiatives, and the evolution of Akiko into a scalable consumer fintech platform.

management_commitments.claim: The iOS version of AkikoPay is planned to launch in the coming months.
management_commitments.quote: The iOS version is progressing as planned and is expected to offer a similar comprehensive experience in the coming months.

management_commitments.quote: I would like to give an outlook for FY27, which approximately I am expecting a target of 70% to 100% revenue growth, we have taken a minimum.

management_commitments.quote: We have a proper clear vision that we build INR1,000 crores revenue by 2030 and take PAT margins further to 12% to 13%.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets reaching 5 lakh AkikoPay customers by September 30th and 1 million customers by December 31st.
management_commitments.quote: Yes. In this I have planned that in quarter one or two, we will be live everywhere, so I am expecting 5 lakh customers by 30th of September and 1 million customers till 31st December.

management_commitments.claim: Management targets scaling the unsecured loan book to INR 1,000 crores by the end of FY27.
management_commitments.quote: By FY27, my target is INR1,000 crores of unsecured book.

management_commitments.claim: Founder Ankur Gaba plans to assume the role of Managing Director within the next one or two months.
management_commitments.quote: Yes, 100%. Most likely in the next one or two months.

_meta.note: Facts are verbatim-grounded against the company's own documents; claims whose quote was not found were dropped.
